sections.description: Custom Gutenberg blocks and admin UX for Styrk Reklame sites.
sections.changelog:
First stable release, after a full QA of every block (2026-10-23 to 2026-10-27).

- **QA:** all 33 blocks tested at 320–3840px with axe-core (WCAG 2.2 AA) and IBM Equal Access, keyboard walk, and editor → save → front-end E2E coverage for every block. Every finding fixed (#542, #543, #561–#567, #575–#578).
- **Editor:** neutral editor panel colours with theme overrides (#545), aligned control rows and a calm advanced section (#544), plain-language contrast warning (#547), News block v1 panel (#546), feature-cards «Steg» layout (#580).
- **Settings:** Header, Footer and Search grouped by task (#549).
- **Chat:** Styrk sees all Chat settings; clients see them only once a key is active, without key, limits or robot check (#568, #583). Clearer answers, no why-spirals, crisp feedback icons (#537).
- **Releases:** the standalone chatbot
